function.name: propose_changes
function.description: Propose schedule/goal/reminder changes. The user sees a preview card and must confirm — nothing is applied directly. Use presentation "preview" for explicit user commands and "suggestion" for plans that are your own idea.

message.description: Short coaching message to show with the plan (used when you return no assistant text).

parameters.description: EXACT keys per actionType — createTask/editTask: title, time ("HH:mm" 24-hour), duration (minutes, integer), date ("today" | "tomorrow" | YYYY-MM-DD); editTask/moveTask/deleteTask/addReminder/removeReminder/rescheduleReminder: taskRef (the [t1]-style handle shown next to the existing task — preferred) or taskTitle; modifyGoal/deleteGoal: goalRef (the [g1] handle) or goalTitle; moveTask: destinationDate; createGoal: title, target (number + unit, e.g. "25 minutes", "3 sessions", "20 km"), deadline, cadence ("daily" | "weekly" | "monthly" | "none"), category ("fitness" | "study" | "productivity" | "focus" | "habits" | "mental_clarity"); modifyGoal: goalTitle, field ("title" | "target" | "deadline" | "intensity"), newValue; deleteGoal: goalTitle; addReminder/rescheduleReminder: taskTitle, reminderTime ("HH:mm"); removeReminder: taskTitle. Never use startTime/start/when/durationMinutes — the app reads only the keys above.

function.name: get_day_schedule
function.description: Read the tasks scheduled on a specific day that is not already in your context (context always includes today and tomorrow).
